scope: Independent read-only replay of saved score arrays and summary accounting; no source generation or model fitting.
checks: Frozen source, runner and test hashes
Native two-stage signed-permutation mixing scores reconstructed independently
Native constrained-permutation/sign graph scores reconstructed independently
